text.en: About once each cycle, an ovary releases an egg into the fallopian tube.
text.hg: Har cycle mein lagbhag ek baar ovary ek egg fallopian tube mein release karti hai.

text.en: One sperm joins the egg, usually in the tube, and one new cell is formed.
text.hg: Ek sperm egg se milta hai, aam taur par tube mein, aur ek nayi cell banti hai.

text.en: About a week later, it settles into the soft lining of the uterus, and periods stop.
text.hg: Lagbhag ek hafte baad yeh uterus ki soft lining mein settle ho jaata hai, aur periods ruk jaate hain.

text.en: The placenta and umbilical cord carry oxygen and nutrients from the pregnant person's blood to the baby.
text.hg: Placenta aur umbilical cord pregnant person ke blood se oxygen aur nutrients baby tak pahunchate hain.

text.en: About 40 weeks after the last period began, the baby is born through the vagina or by caesarean section.
text.hg: Last period shuru hone se lagbhag 40 hafte baad, baby vagina ke raaste ya caesarean section se paida hota hai.

title.en: What a home test can and cannot tell
title.hg: Home test kya bata sakta hai, kya nahi

points.en: Whether hCG, the pregnancy hormone, is in your urine
points.hg: Urine mein pregnancy hormone hCG hai ya nahi

points.en: Most reliable from the first day of a missed period
points.hg: Period miss hone ke pehle din se sabse reliable

points.en: A positive is very likely right; a too-early negative can be wrong
points.hg: Positive result almost pakka sahi; bahut jaldi kiya negative galat ho sakta hai

points.en: How many weeks along the pregnancy is
Whether it is in the uterus or in the wrong place
points.hg: Pregnancy uterus mein hai ya galat jagah par
Pregnancy theek se develop ho rahi hai ya nahi

points.en: A doctor can check these, so go early after a positive test
points.hg: Yeh doctor check kar sakte hain, isliye positive test ke baad jaldi jao

text.en: Begin in the first three months; check-ups are free at government health centres.
text.hg: Pehle teen mahinon mein hi shuru karo; government health centres par check-ups free hote hain.

text.en: Severe headache, blurred vision, swollen face or hands, bleeding, fever or less baby movement need a doctor.
text.hg: Tez sir dard, dhundhla dikhna, chehre ya haathon par sujan, bleeding, bukhaar ya baby ki movement kam hona: doctor ko dikhao.

text.en: One-sided lower abdominal pain, bleeding, shoulder-tip pain or fainting in early pregnancy means hospital now; call 112 if someone collapses.
text.hg: Early pregnancy mein lower abdomen mein ek taraf dard, bleeding, shoulder-tip pain ya behoshi ho, toh abhi hospital jao; koi gir pade toh 112 par call karo.

text.en: It usually comes from a chance chromosome problem, not from work, stairs, travel, stress or spicy food.
text.hg: Iski usual wajah chromosomes mein chance se hui problem hoti hai, na ki kaam, seedhiyan, travel, stress ya spicy khaana.

text.en: Say 'I am sorry, this was not your fault' and listen. Tele-MANAS 14416 offers free support.
text.hg: Bolo 'mujhe bahut dukh hai, isme tumhari galti nahi thi' aur suno. Tele-MANAS 14416 par free support milta hai.

title.hg: Fertility: log kya galat samajhte hain

points.en: Pregnancy should happen in the very first month of trying
points.hg: Try karne ke pehle hi mahine mein pregnancy ho jaani chahiye

points.en: If a couple cannot conceive, the woman is to blame
points.hg: Baby na ho toh galti aurat ki hai

points.en: Years of contraception make you infertile
points.hg: Saalon tak contraception use karne se infertility ho jaati hai

points.en: A special powder or 'guaranteed' cure will fix it
points.hg: Koi special powder ya 'guaranteed' cure ise theek kar dega

points.en: Several months is normal; the fertile window is only about six days
points.hg: Kai mahine lagna normal hai; fertile window sirf lagbhag chhe din ki hoti hai

points.en: The cause can lie with either partner or both, so both get checked
points.hg: Wajah kisi bhi partner mein ya dono mein ho sakti hai, isliye check-up dono ka ho

points.en: Fertility returns after stopping; after the injection it can take months
points.hg: Band karne ke baad fertility wapas aa jaati hai; injection ke baad kuch mahine lag sakte hain

points.en: Qualified specialists treat the cause, and no treatment is guaranteed
points.hg: Qualified specialists wajah ka treatment karte hain, aur koi bhi treatment guaranteed nahi hota

text.en: The law needs an adult woman's own consent, not her husband's or parents' permission.
text.hg: Law ko adult woman ki apni consent chahiye, pati ya parents ki permission nahi.

text.en: Antenatal care, delivery in government hospitals and child vaccines are free; ASHA and anganwadi workers help locally.
text.hg: Antenatal care, government hospital mein delivery aur bachchon ke vaccines free hain; ASHA aur anganwadi workers local level par help karti hain.

text.en: A legal process through CARA and the Child Welfare Committee; handing a baby over privately is illegal.
text.hg: CARA aur Child Welfare Committee ke through legal process; baby ko private taur par kisi ko de dena illegal hai.

text.en: Legal up to 20 weeks on one doctor's opinion, later only in specified cases; covers married and unmarried women.
text.hg: 20 hafte tak ek doctor ki opinion par legal, uske baad sirf specified cases mein; married aur unmarried dono women par laagu.

text.en: Unsupervised pills or untrained providers can cause heavy bleeding, infection and death.
text.hg: Doctor ki supervision ke bina pills ya untrained log heavy bleeding, infection aur maut tak ki wajah ban sakte hain.

text.en: Heavy bleeding, fever, chest pain, breathlessness or thoughts of harming yourself or the baby need help immediately.
text.hg: Heavy bleeding, bukhaar, chest pain, saans phoolna, ya khud ko ya baby ko harm karne ke khayal aayein, toh turant help lo.

title.en: Sons, daughters and blame: the facts
title.hg: Bete, betiyan aur blame: asli facts

text.en: Finding out or revealing a foetus's sex is illegal under the PC-PNDT Act, 1994.
text.hg: PC-PNDT Act, 1994 ke under foetus ka sex pata karna ya batana illegal hai.

text.en: Abortion with a qualified doctor is legal healthcare under the MTP Act; choosing by sex is the crime.
text.hg: MTP Act ke under qualified doctor se abortion legal healthcare hai; crime hai sex dekh kar choose karna.

label.hg: Baby ka sex chance se tay hota hai

text.en: Every egg carries X; a sperm carries X or Y, by pure chance. No diet, ritual or medicine changes it.
text.hg: Har egg mein X hota hai; sperm X ya Y mein se koi ek laata hai, aur kaunsa, yeh pure chance hai. Koi diet, ritual ya medicine ise nahi badal sakti.

text.en: Male factors are involved roughly as often as female ones, and a semen test is simple and painless.
text.hg: Male factors lagbhag utni hi baar involved hote hain jitne female, aur semen test simple aur painless hota hai.

label.hg: Unsafe abortion jaan le sakta hai

text.en: Untrained providers or pills without a doctor's check can cause death or infertility; government hospitals give safe care.
text.hg: Untrained log ya doctor ke check ke bina pills maut ya infertility tak la sakti hain; government hospitals mein safe care milti hai.

text.en: Whether and when to have a child is a decision. If you are being forced, call 181 or 112.
text.hg: Baby ho ya nahi, aur kab, yeh ek decision hai. Agar tumhe force kiya ja raha hai, toh 181 ya 112 par call karo.
